mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever the rate is low, which is the current regime as of 2019-06-15.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.08% is near historic lows
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation, measured by a 1-month year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3%, signals central bank tightening and increased equity risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL 1-month change > 0.3% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS 1-month change > 0.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (PAYEMS 1-month change > 0.5% AND UNRATE < 4.0%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annualized and HOUST above 850.0 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the Federal Reserve initiates tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods in the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST > 850.0) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO 1-month change < -0.2%) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with INDPRO 1-month change < -0.2% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.08% and CPIAUCSL at 233.808
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods in the monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.0%) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST 1-month change > 0.5%) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with HOUST 1-month change > 0.5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
